response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his resume shows minimal direct evidence of the core GenAI requirements: no mention of RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), or cloud-native AI system design. The only AI-adjacent experience is a brief, vague reference to 'AI-agent infrastructure' and MCP code generators in his current role, which is far short of the 8+ years of production AI-solution delivery and customer-facing technical leadership on GenAI systems this Staff FDE role demands.
strengths: 20+ years of diverse, deep software engineering experience across many stacks and domains
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source ownership
Demonstrated experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and current involvement in agentic workflow tooling
concerns: No demonstrated experience with RAG architectures or vector databases
No evidence of multi-agent framework usage (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.) or LLM performance/evaluation work
Lacks explicit major cloud platform AI-system design experience and customer-facing technical discovery leadership for AI solutions

key_factors.factor: Absence of RAG/vector DB/LLM evaluation experience
Limited, vague GenAI/agentic experience (only recent, brief mention)
Extensive senior/staff-level engineering and leadership background
